# Mono for VS Code

Greyscale themes from [mono-ui](https://github.com/MaggiNephew/mono-ui): Mono Square, Round and Blend (dark) and Mono Paper (light).

Install from this folder: `npx @vscode/vsce package` then `code --install-extension mono-ui-theme-*.vsix`, or copy the folder into `~/.vscode/extensions/`.
